diagnosis.root_cause: The rollout of WAF managed ruleset 2026.05.12 introduced a rule (100417) containing nested quantifiers in its pattern, causing regex evaluations to exceed the 40ms budget, which spiked edge-proxy CPU utilization and led to a high rate of 5xx errors.
evidence: edge-proxy / cpu_utilization_pct spiked from 34.5% to near 100% starting at 13:43 UTC
edge-proxy / http_5xx_rate spiked from 0.002 to ~0.628 starting at 13:44 UTC
deploy at 2026-05-12T13:42:00Z rolled out WAF managed ruleset 2026.05.12 adding ~30 new rules including rule 100417
waf-engine log at 2026-05-12T13:42:45Z showing ERROR: regex evaluation exceeded 40ms budget on managed rule 100417 (pattern contains nested quantifiers: (?:.*.*=.*))
diagnosis.recommended_fix: Roll back the WAF managed ruleset 2026.05.12 deploy immediately to restore normal CPU utilization and HTTP 5xx error rates on the edge tier. As a follow-up, fix the regex pattern for rule 100417 to remove nested quantifiers before re-releasing.
